4Q92 1:1.en: YHWH made in the heavens and in the earth to make it has done do there is not that there is not as YHWH and there is not who has done as the king gods in seas and in all the deeps
4Q92 1:1.notes: Positions 17-18 contain uncertain text. Positions 1-2 and 9-10 reflect repeated phrase evidence.

4Q92 1:2.en: Ascending, chiefs from the end of the earth, lightning for rain he makes, going out [the] wind from his supply: who struck the first-born of Egypt from humankind unto cattle.
4Q92 1:2.notes: Uncertain reconstruction of "ascending" and "first-born" (positions 1, 18). Uncertain lemma for position 13. Uncertain punctuation at positions 15, 24.

4Q92 1:3.en: Signs and wonders in the midst of Egypt, in Pharaoh and on all his servants. Who struck many nations, mighty kings. Sihon the king of the Amorite
4Q92 1:3.notes: The phrase 'in the midst of Egypt' is supported by repeated phrase evidence. 'Many nations' is a high-confidence contextual rendering. 'Sihon the king' is a repeated phrase with strong support. The final phrase is uncertain due to damage and reconstruction.

4Q92 1:4.en: and to Og the king of Bashan and to all the kingdoms of Canaan and he gave their land as an inheritance to Israel YHWH forever
4Q92 1:4.notes: positions 12 and 21 are untranslatable punctuation marks

4Q92 1:5.en: YHWH's mention to a generation and generation: that he will judge YHWH's people and upon his servants he will repent. The images of the peoples, silver and gold, the work of the hands of humankind. Mouth.
4Q92 1:5.notes: Positions 22 and 26 are uncertain. Positions 7, 16, 26, and 28 are untranslatable.

4Q92 2:3.en: Of David a psalm to YHWH he reigns let peoples quake with the inhabitants of cherubs she stretches out the earth YHWH in Zion great and high he upon all
4Q92 2:3.notes: Uncertain reconstruction at positions 1-2. Uncertain gloss at position 10. Phrase evidence supports 'of David a psalm' and 'YHWH in Zion' but not all connections. No recoverable text for position 13.

4Q92 2:4.en: The people: they will praise your great and awesome holy name. And the king's power loved you: you established uprightness, justice, and righteousness in Jacob, you did.
4Q92 2:4.notes: Positions 3, 11, 27: Untranslatable colon punctuation. Position 2: Uncertain reading. Positions 4-5: Reconstructed verb and suffixed noun. Position 8: Participle from 'fear' used adjectivally. Positions 17-18: Second person masculine singular perfect polel stem of כון with second person masculine singular pronoun.

4Q92 2:5.en: Exalt Yahweh our God and bow down to the footstool of his feet holy is he
4Q92 2:5.notes: The phrase 'exalt Yahweh our God' is supported by repeated phrase evidence. 'Bow down to the footstool of his feet' is a high-confidence contextual rendering. The final 'holy is he' is a conservative translation of the visible morphology, though the exact relationship between 'holy' and 'he' is uncertain due to the fragmentary state of the text.
